overallExplanation: Mr. Kelvin Masumba's leadership at the Food Reserve Agency presents serious concerns across every dimension of assessment. FRA is an institution in crisis: strategic grain reserves are dangerously below the food security threshold, 45,000 metric tonnes of grain were lost to poor storage, 85,000 farmers were driven to seek alternative buyers due to payment delays, and the Auditor General has flagged 8 material findings. The financial model is unsustainable, operational efficiency is among the worst in the region, and governance failures have attracted ACC investigations and stalled development partner engagement. While Mr. Masumba was appointed relatively recently and inherited many systemic problems, the pace of reform has been inadequate to the urgency of the situation. Immediate, comprehensive intervention is required to prevent further deterioration of national food security infrastructure.
topImprovementAreas: Urgently rebuild the strategic grain reserve to the 500,000 metric tonne food security threshold and eliminate storage losses
